copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 加上 WhatsApp 频道：通过原生 Baileys 适配器直连 WhatsApp Web，不用 Chat SDK 桥接。它会从 channels 分支复制适配器与测试、装好依赖、构建并跑注册测试，再用二维码或配对码链接设备。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp 频道时触发。安装或认证前它必先问这个号是专用号还是你常用的共用号；若是共用号，会先给出账号风险警告并要你明确确认。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 加上 WhatsApp 频道
say.note: 开始走复制适配器、装依赖、构建和测试的流程

say.text: 用二维码方式链接 WhatsApp
say.note: 终端会显示二维码，用手机扫码完成关联

say.text: 我用的是专用号，不是常用号
say.note: 跳过共用号风险警告，按专用号安装

howto.what_en: Adds a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw via the native Baileys adapter — a direct WhatsApp Web link, no Chat SDK bridge. It copies the adapter and test from the channels branch, installs deps, builds, runs the registration test, then links the device by QR or pairing code.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw. Before installing or authenticating it always asks whether the number is dedicated or your shared everyday number, and warns about account risk for a shared number.

say_en.text: Add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter, installing deps, building and testing

say_en.text: Link WhatsApp with a QR code
say_en.note: A QR code appears in the terminal to scan with your phone

say_en.text: I'm using a dedicated number, not my everyday one
say_en.note: Skips the shared-number risk warning and installs as dedicated
